en.activeNone: No backend is ready yet. Open a card below and click “Get API key”.
en.baiduKeyHint: Qianfan search. You can also set BAIDU_API_KEY or QIANFAN_API_KEY.
en.baiduModeHint: Ordinary search is faster and returns titles, links, and snippets. AI search adds a model summary and is slower.
en.baiduModelHint: Required only for AI search, for example ernie-4.5-turbo-32k.
en.baiduNote: AI search uses a model summary. Knowledge-style queries often return a summary with no web citations.
en.blurb: Point official web_search and web_fetch at a backend on this page, or keep DSH built-in.
en.builtinNote: Using DSH built-in search (deepseek-official) and built-in HTTP extract. Keys on this page are unused.
en.customSearchHint: When off, both tools stay on DSH built-in. When on, pick a search backend here; page extract can be chosen separately.
en.doubaoKeyHint: Doubao Search console. You can also set DOUBAO_API_KEY or DOUBAO_SEARCH_API_KEY.
en.doubaoModeHint: Custom is better for Chinese results and filters. Global covers international pages.
en.empty: Config is not loaded yet. Restart dsh web and reopen this page.
en.exaDesc: Search returns links; can also fetch page content
en.exaNote: Exa search has no answer, only links.
en.exaProviderIdHint: Default is exa. Use another id if the official Exa plugin is also loaded.
en.exaTypeHint: Auto lets Exa choose between keyword and neural search.
en.fetchHint: Independent of search. Auto uses Tavily or Exa when that search backend is active; otherwise DSH HTTP.
en.keysHint: One vendor is enough. “Get API key” in the panel below opens that vendor’s console.
en.providerHint: Auto picks Baidu → Doubao → Tavily → Exa → Serper, and tries the next if one fails. An explicit pick stays on that vendor.
en.secretHint: Saved keys show as password dots and are never echoed back. Type a new key and press Enter or click away to save. Clear, or empty the field, removes that key from ~/.dsh/settings.yaml. Keys can also live in credentials or ~/.dsh/.env — do not export them inside an agent. Use web_search and web_fetch, do not curl.
en.serperGlHint: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, for example us or cn. Leave empty for Serper’s default.
en.serperHlHint: Interface language, for example en or zh-cn. Leave empty for Serper’s default.
en.serperNote: An answer box is returned as the summary when present.
en.setup2: Click “Get API key”, create one in the console, then paste it here
en.setup3: Click “Test connection”; after it passes, web_search can use it
en.tavilyDepthHint: Basic is faster and cheaper; advanced recalls more.
en.tavilyDesc: Search includes an answer; can also fetch page content
en.tavilyExtractHint: Used only when page content routes to Tavily. Advanced is more complete, slower, and costs more.
en.title: Web search
